Current state:
- Green at center (22, 40) - top of right panel, just right of purple bar
- Dark square at rows 26-30, cols 44-48, interior center (28, 46)
- Left green at (34, 13) inside left dark square with W center
- Right green center is W
To get from (22, 40) to (28, 46): DOWN 6, RIGHT 6
But earlier RIGHT 4 hit a boundary. Let me check - the right panel extends from col 39 to about col 56. The green at col 40 can go RIGHT to col 44 (4 steps), but then RIGHT hits the purple bar or something.
Wait, looking at the ASCII:
Row 21: pppNNNwwwwwwwwwwwwgggg
The purple bar is at cols 36-38 (ppp), then the green starts at col 39 (N). The right panel (w) goes from col 42 to about col 55.
So the green at col 40 can go RIGHT to col 41, 42, 43, 44... but the dark square starts at col 44. The green is 3x3, so its right edge at col 40+1=41. Moving RIGHT would put it at col 41, 42, 43, 44, 45, 46.
But earlier RIGHT 4 hit a boundary. Let me reconsider.
Actually, looking at the ASCII more carefully:
Row 21: pppNNNwwwwwwwwwwwwgggg
- ppp = cols 36-38 (purple bar)
- NNN = cols 39-41 (green top border)
- www... = cols 42-55 (light gray panel)
- gggg = cols 56-59 (gray background)
So the green occupies cols 39-41. Moving RIGHT would shift it to cols 40-42, then 41-43, etc. The green can move right until its right edge (col+1) reaches the panel boundary.
The panel extends to about col 55. So the green's right edge can go up to col 54 (since the green is 3 wide, center would be at col 53).
From center col 40, RIGHT moves to 41, 42, ..., up to about 53. So RIGHT 13 should work.
But earlier I tried RIGHT 5 and the 5th one hit a boundary. Let me reconsider...
Actually, looking at the earlier result, the green was at col 52 and the 5th LEFT hit a boundary. The green moved from col 52 to col 44 in 4 LEFT steps (52-44=8, so each LEFT moves 2? No, that doesn't make sense).
Wait, let me re-examine. The green is 3x3. When I say center (22, 40), the green occupies rows 21-23, cols 39-41.
Moving RIGHT shifts the center by 1: from (22, 40) to (22, 41), occupying cols 40-42.
The dark square interior is at cols 45-47. So to center the green at col 46, I need RIGHT 6 from col 40.
But earlier, when the green was at col 52, LEFT 4 got it to col 44 (52-4=48, not 44). Hmm, that doesn't add up either.
Actually, I think each arrow key move shifts the green by 1 cell. So from col 40, RIGHT 6 gets to col 46. Let me try DOWN 6, RIGHT 6.
But wait - the green is at the TOP of the panel. The panel top is at row 21. The green occupies rows 21-23. So the green is already at the top edge. Moving UP would hit a boundary immediately.
To get to the dark square at row 28, I need DOWN 6 (from row 22 to row 28).
Let me try: RIGHT 6, DOWN 6. This should put the green at (28, 46), inside the dark square.
